# Synthetic urban atlas

Original synthetic geometry and composition, copyright 2026 Kernerian, BSD
3-Clause. Generated by `examples/urban.py` with the Azimlib renderer. This is
not OSM data or a real/navigable street map. Labels use the bundled DejaVu font,
which retains its own terms; see the repository third-party notices.

`manifest.json` records the PNG dimensions and hash. Reproduce with:

```bash
python examples/urban.py --output gallery/urban
```
